objects.name: Analytic 2114
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies bulk file access on a Linux-hosted Industrial Control System (ICS) documentation repository (piping and instrumentation diagram stores, configuration archives) by a User Identifier (UID) not associated with documented engineering roles. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL+PATH
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL+PATH records: PATH records show sequential reads of ICS documentation/configuration files by a UID not in the authorized engineering or backup account set
